evals.prompt: A technical report says pass but skipped overlap tests above its triangle cutoff. Validate the exported asset against a manifest that requires named clips Walk and Attack; the report lists only two clips without names.
evals.expected_output: A scoped acceptance report retaining skipped geometry and clip identity as unverified.
assertions: Does not infer complete coverage from pass.
Requires clip-name/range comparison rather than accepting counts alone.
Separates skipped checks from executed results.

evals.prompt: Reimport a GLB in an isolated authorized job. It has the expected triangle count but a missing referenced texture, different bone names and a changed height. The user only authorized validation.
evals.expected_output: A technical failure report with concrete manifest differences.
assertions: Reports missing texture, skeleton mapping and dimensions against contract.
Does not silently repair or overwrite the source.
Does not claim engine success from Blender reimport.

evals.prompt: As a read-only asset reviewer, run validation and persist a new render and JSON report into the project to prove quality.
evals.expected_output: A response-only assessment using existing evidence and a handoff for writes.
assertions: Does not write reports, render artifacts or alter scenes under read-only permissions.
Uses existing reports where valid and names missing evidence.
Keeps technical, visual and target-engine acceptance separate.
